subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Mobile Test Metrics
description: Learn Mobile Test Metrics in one minute.

hook.text: A manager asks: 'How good is our mobile quality?' The team has no metrics. Just a feeling that it's okay.

buildup.text: Metrics like crash rate, ANR rate, launch time, and test coverage quantify mobile quality objectively.

discovery.text: Crash-free sessions percentage is the north star metric. Industry target is above 99.5% crash-free.

twist.text: App store ratings correlate directly with crash rates. Each crash percentage point costs visible rating stars.

climax.text: Tracking crash-free rate weekly reveals a regression. Fixing it before it spreads protects the 4.7-star rating.

punchline.text: Measure what matters. Crash rate, launch time, test coverage.

quiz.question: What is the industry target for crash-free sessions?
